The operational processes described in the text reveal two primary bottlenecks that hinder efficiency in the HomeTech customer service department. First, the lack of integration between software systems forces representatives to perform repeated data entry and switch between multiple platforms, causing significant delays. Second, the absence of a centralized knowledge base results in inconsistent information being provided to customers.

To improve efficiency, HomeTech should implement an integrated software ecosystem that allows for seamless data flow across platforms, thereby eliminating redundant data entry. Additionally, establishing a centralized knowledge base would ensure that all representatives have access to consistent, accurate information, improving both service quality and resolution speed.
